label: Backlog-graph bookkeeping + process-contention fix
summary: Killed 12 stale backlog serve processes holding DB lock, worked around Turso adapter FK incompatibility, resolved PERF-MEMORY-004, BUG-MEMORY-008, and BL-496 with citations via the backlog CLI.

db_lock_verification.schema_issue: node_uid_unique IF NOT EXISTS not respected by @tursodatabase/database-common — already caught by existing try/catch in backlog dist

fk_workaround.change: Added PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF before BEGIN in _runTransaction()
fk_workaround.reason: @tursodatabase/database-common native addon rejects FK references on UPDATE node when edge table has REFERENCES node(rowid) ON DELETE CASCADE — standard SQLite handles this; the Turso adapter does not
fk_workaround.note: This is a surgical workaround, not a fix. The Turso adapter needs proper FK support for mutation paths. File to track: bug in @adhd/sox-store-adapter TursoAdapterImpl._runTransaction

resolved_items.citation_context: PERF-MEMORY-004 fix: commits 41f241ef + cd9fcc65 — removed importance=1.0 default, computeImportance before INSERT, userSuppliedImportance flag. Red-green regression test: write.spec.ts PERF-MEMORY-004 block

BUG-MEMORY-008 fix: commits d5836a49 + f4da8bd8 — buildCommunities guard refuses when live level-0 communities exist without force:true; single transaction with MEMBER_OF edge invalidation. Red-green regression test: bug-memory-008-build-communities-guard.spec.ts (5 tests)

BL-496 fix: commit ddd3fa08 — cluster-metrics.ts with time_to_community_ms, bulk-pass exclusion, backlog partitioned by cause, cluster_pipeline in memory_ping. Red-green regression test: bl496-time-to-community.spec.ts

items_remaining_open: Per instructions: BUG-MEMORY-007/010/011/012, BL-495, BL-497, CHORE-MEMORY-001 remain open.

changes.kind: Added PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF before BEGIN in _runTransaction to work around Turso adapter FK incompatibility

tests.command: N/A — no sox-ecosystem code was changed

issues: @tursodatabase/database-common@0.7.2 native addon (database-darwin-arm64) rejects CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS when index already exists — standard SQLite 3.51.0 handles this correctly
@tursodatabase/database-common native addon rejects FK references during UPDATE node when edge table has REFERENCES ON DELETE CASCADE — standard SQLite handles this correctly
The backlog repo has uncommitted changes on main (the store adapter swap from better-sqlite3 to Turso) that introduced both issues
handoff_notes: The Turso adapter FK workaround in node_modules is fragile — a pnpm install will revert it. The proper fix is in the sox-store-adapter source to either disable FK checks during transactions or fix the native addon
Backlog serve process accumulation (12 processes across 4 days) indicates a cleanup mechanism is missing — serve processes should self-terminate when their parent session exits
